name: Ta Xua dinosaur spine (Sống lưng khủng long)
region: Tà Xùa, Bắc Yên, Sơn La
why: A knife-edge grass ridge high above the Sơn La - Yên Bái border, where on winter mornings you stand on a narrow spine over a sea of clouds.
book: Free, no permit. Bắc Yên is 15 km below Tà Xùa on the steep provincial road 112; sleep in a Tà Xùa homestay to be on the ridge at sunrise. Many visitors ride motorbikes along the lane to the spine: on foot you share it with them.
water: None on the ridge: carry 1.5 litres. Cafes and homestays in Tà Xùa.
dangers: The spine is a narrow strip with steep drops on both sides: stay on the path and off the edge, above all in wind or wet grass.
Motorbikes on the narrow lane in both directions.
Cold, fog and dew at dawn in winter: warm layers and shoes with grip.
Slippery red clay in the rainy season (May to September).
turnaround: Fog with rain or strong wind on the ridge: stop at the end of the lane and do not walk out on the spine.

points.name: Ta Xua
points.note: The homestays of Tà Xùa at about 1,450 m. A narrow lane heads east along the ridge towards Háng Đồng.

points.name: End of the ridge lane
points.note: The lane ends and a track carries on along the crest; motorbikes stop around here. Clouds fill the valleys on both sides from October to April.

points.name: Dinosaur spine ridge
points.note: The bare, bumpy crest that gives the place its name, with drops on both sides. Best between 05:00 and 07:00. Back the same way.
